title: Lazy Susan wins Down Under Season 4
summary: In the Grand Finale (DU-S04-E08), Freya Armani was eliminated after the final challenge, leaving Lazy Susan, Mandy Moobs, and Vybe to lip-sync to Sigala and Ella Eyre's "Came Here for Love". Lazy Susan was crowned the winner.

title: Olivia Dreams: Season 4 Porkchop
summary: Olivia Dreams was the first contestant eliminated on Down Under Season 4 (DU-S04-E02), after a double shantay spared Karna Ford and Lucina Innocence in episode 1. She lip-synced to Zoë Badwi's "Freefallin" against Lucina Innocence.

title: Michelle Visage takes over as host
summary: Season 4 was the first Down Under season without RuPaul as host. Michelle Visage hosted, Rhys Nicholson remained a permanent judge, and prior winners Kita Mean, Spankie Jackzon, and Isis Avis Loren rotated as judges. The series was renamed Drag Race Down Under.
